name: Saeki Ruriko
source:
[b]A Villainess, Somehow Hard to Detest[/b]

Zodiac: Leo

A classmate at Acacia Academy, who is in a different squad from [url=/c133874]Yui[/url] and the others. She has a strange laugh like a typical [i]ojousama[/i] character from a [i]manga[/i], but she actually appears to be a daughter of the president. With such a girl as a ruler, is this country going to be alright? Despite being talked behind her back, it looks like she is surprisingly popular. She seems to have a personal connection with [url=/c133875]Akari[/url], often acting harshly toward her.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://orthrossoft.jp/character/ruriko.html#ruriko]official website[/url]]
